title: Design: New Credit Term errors show in red under the field
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • Scenario: You type a name and number that are not allowed in a new term and compare the errors with the design.
  • You are an Admin user working at {Location-A}.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • The browser window is 1440 px wide, at 100% zoom.
    For example: a maximised window on a 1440 x 900 screen.
  • The design picture ct-p3-03-validation-errors.png is attached to this case; open it at 100% zoom beside the screen.
  • Starting screen: the Credit Terms page, Active tab.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Click "New Credit Term".
  2. Type "net 30" in Name.
  3. Type 400 in the Days box.
  4. Resize the browser window to 1536 px wide (for example, maximise it on a 1536 x 864 screen at 100% zoom).
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the "New Credit Term" window opens with no error showing.
  • Step 2: Name reads "net 30".
  • Step 3: both the Name box and the Days box have a red border and a red label; under Name the red message "Net 30 is already a standard term. Pick another name." and under Days the red message "Enter 1 to 365 days."; "Create Credit Term" is pale blue (disabled) (as in ct-p3-03-validation-errors.png).
  • Step 4: at 1536 px nothing overlaps, nothing is cut off and nothing needs a sideways scroll; the layout described above is unchanged, only wider.

Whether the blue line shows while only the Name is wrong is question 10 (CT-D03, D-52 held); this case types two wrong values, where design and PRD agree that no blue line shows.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11672 (Story 3, Create or edit a credit term)

  • S3-R9: “Validation rules and their exact messages, shown under the field:”
  • S3-R9, a standard term's name: “Name matches a standard term ignoring capitals and spaces (for example "net 30" or "Net30"): "{Standard name} is already a standard term. Pick another name." (for example "Net 30 is already a standard term. Pick another name.")”
  • S3-R9, Days: “Days not a whole number from 1 to 365: "Enter 1 to 365 days."”
  • S3-R6: “"Create Credit Term" / "Save Changes" stays disabled until the Name and the chosen box are both valid.”
  • User Feedback Summary: “Name matches a standard term | "{name} is already a standard term. Pick another name." | Inline error, persists until corrected”
  • User Feedback Summary: “Days out of range | "Enter 1 to 365 days." | Inline error, clears as soon as the number is valid”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

References from Design

Design canvas "Default Credit Terms" (https://claude.ai/artifact/2erYxWz2ffDNcoXzEfu6wf), read 23 Oct 2026: page "3 New credit term and Inactive tab" ("Validation errors"). Compare the screen with the pictures below; the expected results above come from the PRD quotes, except where this held design case follows the design.

Design pictures attached to this case:

  • ct-p3-03-validation-errors.png

The design's own words:

  • “Names are compared ignoring capitals and spaces, against standard terms and the shop's own ("A term called Net 10 already exists.").”
  • “Create Credit Term stays disabled until every field is valid. Errors show only after a field is touched or Create is pressed; the Name field is never red when the window opens.”
